bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
work="$repo/.worktrees/one-tap-invite-20261115"
compose="$repo/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
name=deploy-gaybbs-1
image=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:invite-copy-f62d8c3d
backup=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-invite-copy-20261115
test -f "$compose" || exit 67
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true || exit 63
prior="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$name")"
expected="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:restore-completed-f19f4f5)" || exit 74
test "$prior" = "$expected" || { echo ACTIVE_IMAGE_CHANGED;exit 74; }
git -C "$repo" fetch --no-tags origin fix/restore-search-profile-room-preserve-menu-20261115
test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = f62d8c3d8b0927b7d32fcd841428d24b7b8ca59b || exit 74
if test -d "$work";then
 test -z "$(git -C "$work" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" || exit 76
 test "$(git -C "$work" rev-parse HEAD)" = f62d8c3d8b0927b7d32fcd841428d24b7b8ca59b || exit 74
else
 git -C "$repo" worktree add --detach "$work" f62d8c3d8b0927b7d32fcd841428d24b7b8ca59b
fi
log="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$log"' EXIT
if ! docker build --network=host -f "$work/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t "$image" "$work" >"$log" 2>&1;then
 if grep -Eq 'ERR_PNPM|frozen-lockfile' "$log";then exit 51;fi
 if grep -Eq 'no space left|ENOSPC' "$log";then exit 52;fi
 exit 55
fi
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$image" --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null || exit 81
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$image")"
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" config --quiet || exit 68
docker image tag "$prior" "$backup"
cat > "$work/invite-override.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  gaybbs:
    image: gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:invite-copy-f62d8c3d
    pull_policy: never
YAML
cat > "$work/invite-rollback.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  gaybbs:
    image: gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-invite-copy-20261115
    pull_policy: never
YAML
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$work/invite-override.yaml" config --quiet || exit 69
changed=0
recover(){ rc=$?;trap - ERR;set +e;if test "$changed" = 1;then docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$work/invite-rollback.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo INVITE_DEPLOY_ROLLBACK=PASS || echo INVITE_DEPLOY_ROLLBACK=FAIL;fi;exit "$rc"; }
trap recover ERR
changed=1
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$work/invite-override.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps gaybbs >/dev/null
sleep 8
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$name")" = "$newid" || false
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true || false
trap - ERR
echo INVITE_COPY_SOURCE_DEPLOY=PASS
echo SOURCE=f62d8c3d8b0927b7d32fcd841428d24b7b8ca59b
echo IMAGE_ID="$newid"
echo USERBOT="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
